description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim (RCMM), in collaboration with the Department of Psychology, SNDT
Women’s University, Churchgate, organized a panel discussion on 13th October 2026 to commemorate
World Mental Health Day.
The discussion, titled “Beyond the Individual – Rethinking Mental Health through Professional and
Personal Lenses,” explored mental health as a concern that extends beyond the individual,
encompassing family relationships, workplace environments, social expectations and the larger
community. The distinguished panel comprised Dr. Shubhangi Parkar, Professor and Dean, Vedanta Institute of
Medical Sciences; Ms. Veena Fernandes, Strategic HR Leader, Founder and Owner of Statue Painting;
and Dr. Chandana Shet, Counselling Psychologist at Manodyan Counselling Centre and ACE Hospital.
The session was moderated by Dr. Nilesh Thakre, Professor and Head of the Department of
Psychology, SNDT Women’s University.
